items.label: Latest Data
items.value: If you often feel overwhelmed by complex roads and buildings, then this navigation SD card may be able to help you! The replacement part number for the Navigation SD card is 86271-0E075, which covers all the latest map data for the US and Canada from 2022-2023. Our map data comes from the latest data on the official website, it was only released as a 2023 update, the data always lags behind the actual calendar year, the copyright notice does say 2023. This is a normal phenomenon!

items.label: Accurate Aavigation
items.value: The latest map update navigation Micro GPS map card 86271 0E075 includes new and expanded coverage in 50 cities, counties, and metropolitan areas in the United States and Canada. A small SD card carries information on hundreds of millions of roads and buildings. Whether you go to tourism, hotels, gas stations, towns, villages, pet store, barber shops and other places, it can provide you with a powerful and accurate data flow to help you quickly reach your destination.

items.label: Premium Chip
items.value: The car GPS navigation system SD card is made of premium chips and 8 pins. It has 32GB of memory and high speed data processing ability, which is not easily burned or damaged during use. It only supports vehicles using micro SD cards for navigation. Before purchasing, please carefully confirm that your navigation system contains a micro SD card slot and ensure that the OEM number of the product is compatible with your car.

items.value: Before installation, the car needs to be closed first, After inserting the card into the slot, turn on the engine. Wait for the process to complete. Close the card cover on the panel.
